Used within NestJS Minimal recipe for Zerops platform.","recipeSlug":"nestjs-minimal","fit":"exact","retrievalScore":0.85,"importYaml":"# AI agent environment provides a development space for AI agents to build and
# version the app.
# It includes a dev service with the code repository and necessary development
# tools, a staging service, and a low-resource database.

# No project-level secrets needed — NestJS minimal uses no encryption keys or
# CSRF tokens. Database credentials are auto-generated by the managed PostgreSQL
# service and wired via cross-service references in zerops.yaml.
project:
  name: nestjs-minimal-agent

services:
  # AI agent workspace — zeropsSetup:dev deploys the full source tree so the
  # agent can SSH in, edit TypeScript over SSHFS, and run `npm run start:dev`
  # for hot-reload. Subdomain provides a public URL for the agent to verify
  # dashboard output and health endpoints.
  - hostname: appdev
    type: nodejs@22
    zeropsSetup: dev
    buildFromGit: https://github.com/zerops-recipe-apps/nestjs-minimal-app
    enableSubdomainAccess: true
    verticalAutoscaling:
      minRam: 0.5

  # Staging slot for the agent — cross-deploy with zeropsSetup:prod compiles
  # TypeScript via `npm run build`, prunes devDependencies, and runs the
  # compiled JS with `node dist/main.js` to validate the production build before
  # finishing the task.
  - hostname: appstage
    type: nodejs@22
    zeropsSetup: prod
    buildFromGit: https://github.com/zerops-recipe-apps/nestjs-minimal-app
    enableSubdomainAccess: true
    verticalAutoscaling:
      minRam: 0.5

  # PostgreSQL — stores the greetings table used by the dashboard CRUD demo.
  # TypeORM synchronize handles schema in dev; the migrate.ts script handles it
  # in prod. NON_HA is appropriate for a dev/staging database. Priority 10
  # ensures db accepts connections before app containers attempt migrations.
  - hostname: db
    type: postgresql@18
    priority: 10
    mode: NON_HA
    verticalAutoscaling:
      minRam: 0.25

project:
  name: nodejs-hello-world-agent

services:
  # Set up the AI agent development environment — Zerops pulls
  # source and zerops.yaml from the 'buildFromGit' repo, using
  # the 'dev' setup which installs Node.js 22 and all
  # dependencies. SSH in and start developing.
  # Subdomain access gives the dev workspace a public HTTPS URL
  # so AI agents can verify endpoints during development.
  - hostname: appdev
    type: nodejs@22
    zeropsSetup: dev
    buildFromGit: https://github.com/zerops-recipe-apps/nodejs-hello-world-app
    enableSubdomainAccess: true
    verticalAutoscaling:
      # Low allocation for an idle dev workspace — scale up
      # via verticalAutoscaling settings when needed.
      minRam: 0.5

  # Deploy the staging service — Zerops pulls source from
  # the 'buildFromGit' repo and uses the 'prod' zeropsSetup
  # to compile TypeScript and deploy optimized artifacts.
  # Subdomain provides a public HTTPS URL for testing builds.
  - hostname: appstage
    type: nodejs@22
    zeropsSetup: prod
    buildFromGit: https://github.com/zerops-recipe-apps/nodejs-hello-world-app
    enableSubdomainAccess: true
    verticalAutoscaling:
      minRam: 0.5

  # PostgreSQL single-node database shared by 'appdev' and
  # 'appstage'. Priority 10 starts data services before app
  # containers, preventing connection errors on first boot.
  # NON_HA is appropriate for dev/staging where HA durability
  # isn't required.
  - hostname: db
    type: postgresql@18
    mode: NON_HA
    priority: 10
    verticalAutoscaling:
      minRam: 0.25
